message: `toRef` treats a function source as a getter ref and ignores this key
help: The `'value'` key is also ignored on getters. Pass the function alone, or bind a property on an object source.

message: `getter` is a ref object used as an operand; unwrap with `.value` (or `toValue`)
help: Use `getter.value` (or `toValue(getter)`) when reading the inner value.
